reason: The single store holds project, files, tabs, debug, console and settings slices. Split by slice into stores or slice creators with the same public hook (WP-40); the store split is the IDE state work of WS-24a.

One class holds the serial transport, the command framing, the upload and the debug commands. Split the framing and parsing from the commands behind the same adapter interface; the device protocol work (COM) owns the file.

The lower workbench and the bodies of its Output, Problems, Tests, Changes, Agent and Trace tabs in one component that shares one busy flag and the workspace-test state; the other tabs (Explorer, Inspector, Interlocks, Lab, Learn, Terminal, Watch) already have their own module. The remaining panels cannot move before Console.tabNavigation.test.ts, which pins the text of this file, is replaced by render tests (VF-007), and WS-24a (notifications) edits it first.

Build, run, deploy, connect and export controls and their handlers (about 700 lines of handlers) in one component. Split the handlers into hooks by control group once the notification and progress work (IDE-021, WS-24a) has settled them.
Every tool operation (inspect, compile, check, safety, tests, scenarios, firmware) in one module. Split by operation family; the cancellable worker work (IDE-012) touches the same file.
Connection, polling, forces, breakpoints and trace in one hook. Split by concern; the worker and notification work (WS-24a) edits it first.
Ladder model types, validation and edit operations in one module; the visual-language work (WS-22a) is changing it. Split model, validation and operations after that lands.
Rung grid layout, drag and drop and cell rendering in one component; the visual-language work (WS-22a) edits it. Split after that lands.
Window, menus, IPC handlers and the native simulation host in one module; the IPC contract work (IDE-017, WS-24a) restructures it. Split into one module per handler family there.
Ladder to ST transpilation in one module; the visual-language work (WS-22a) edits it. Split by pass after that lands.
WASM loading, memory access and the adapter methods in one module. Split loading and memory access; the WASM runtime work (IDE-025) rewrites it.
Ladder element rendering for every element kind in one component; the visual-language work (WS-22a) edits it. Split per element kind after that lands.
